test: [LTB-0055] memory failure discards disposition artifacts only for that candidate
asserts: In a sweep, the failing candidate's handler received its DISPOSITION row before the injected failure (observed twice across candidates), the failed candidate keeps no retained returns while its sibling does, and the handler has no transaction/rollback machinery.
depends_on: observation through handler$append_event_rows during the loop (pin appends P1 non-fill rows at their boundary)
target_or_authority: Observe the failed candidate's in-memory commit of the P1 disposition row instead of the handler append: lean_facts_accept() (dev/lean_core/facts.R:80, where accepted corporate-action rows are committed during the loop; P1 stage loop.R:553). The handler append now happens only in the terminal transfer (lean_facts_emit_ca, facts.R:349), which a failed candidate never reaches (D3-A R9, D3-B 'Error/interrupt': discard unmaterialized records)
justification: Real representation change: under D3 the failing candidate creates the artifact in memory and discards it without any handler call, so the handler-side count drops to one (probe: 'DISPOSITION' once). Moving the observation to the in-memory commit keeps the witness that the failed candidate produced the artifact and it was discarded only for that candidate.
